title: Saudi Arabia GDP Growth (2023)
body_summary: Saudi Arabia recorded strong GDP growth driven by oil revenues and non-oil expansion.
body: Saudi Arabia achieved one of the highest GDP growth rates globally in 2023. The growth was supported by strong oil sector performance and continued expansion of non-oil sectors under Vision 2030.
field_key_takeaways:
• Strong macroeconomic performance
  • Growth supported by diversification strategy
  • Attractive environment for investors

title: Non-oil GDP Growth (2023)
body_summary: Non-oil sectors are steadily expanding as part of diversification efforts.
body: Saudi Arabia’s non-oil GDP continues to grow as the government invests heavily in tourism, logistics, technology, and manufacturing sectors.
field_key_takeaways:
• Diversification is progressing
  • Growth beyond oil sector
  • Strong government support

title: FDI Inflow (2022)
body_summary: Foreign investment is increasing as reforms improve the business environment.
body: Saudi Arabia is attracting increasing levels of foreign direct investment as regulatory reforms and economic transformation programs create new opportunities.

title: Unemployment Rate (2023)
body_summary: Labor market conditions are improving across the Kingdom.
body: Saudi Arabia continues to reduce unemployment through job creation programs and economic reforms, improving labor market participation.

title: Population (2023)
body_summary: Saudi Arabia has a large and growing population supporting market demand.
body: With a population of over 36 million, Saudi Arabia represents a large consumer market with increasing demand across sectors.

title: Internet Penetration (2023)
body_summary: Saudi Arabia has one of the highest internet penetration rates globally.
body: High internet penetration supports digital transformation, e-commerce growth, and technology adoption across industries.

title: E-commerce Market Size (2023)
body_summary: E-commerce continues to grow rapidly in Saudi Arabia.
body: Saudi Arabia’s e-commerce sector is expanding quickly due to digital adoption and consumer demand for online services.
field_key_takeaways:
• Rapid digital growth
  • Strong consumer demand
  • Expanding online economy

title: Inflation Rate (2023)
body_summary: Inflation remains relatively stable compared to global averages.
body: Saudi Arabia maintains controlled inflation levels due to government policies and stable economic conditions.

title: Tourism Contribution to GDP (2023)
body_summary: Tourism is becoming a key contributor to economic growth.
body: Tourism is a strategic sector under Vision 2030, contributing significantly to GDP and attracting international visitors.

title: Oil Production (2023)
body_summary: Saudi Arabia remains one of the world's largest oil producers.
body: Oil production continues to be a major contributor to Saudi Arabia’s economy and global energy markets.
